name: Sextonback
bio: The Aether World's undertaker: a huge, gentle, sloth-like corpse-eater with a ridge of bone-chimes. Passive; the clock is the point.

traits.name: Last Rites
traits.desc: Always knows the location of any dead creature within a mile. On its turn, if within 5 feet of a corpse, it uses its action to eat it: the body is destroyed and anything carried is swallowed. Takes 1 round for a Medium or smaller body, 2 for Large, 4 for Huge. An eaten body cannot be raised or revived short of a wish. Swallowed items can be recovered only from the beast's remains.

traits.name: Docile
traits.desc: Does not attack unless it takes damage, or something is taken out of its mouth or from under its muzzle. Calms again once the provocation is gone and there is a corpse to eat.

traits.name: Toll
traits.desc: While it feeds or is startled, its bone-chimes ring, audible out to 300 feet (DC 10 Perception to hear it coming).

traits.name: Bulwark
traits.desc: Its flank provides total cover to creatures behind it.

traits.name: Slow Mass
traits.desc: Moves through other creatures' spaces as if they were difficult terrain, but cannot end its move in one.

actions.name: Trample
actions.desc: One Large or smaller prone creature in its reach makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw, taking 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage on a failure, half on a success.

reactions.name: Mournful Bellow
reactions.desc: When it first takes damage, every creature within 30 feet makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or is frightened until the end of its next turn.
